title: feat(c11q10): cov11>0 is not Q10; positivity implies Q10
science: Contains an unstated exact selector law: the eight cov11=0 maps it names are precisely the eight tuples with adj2=0 AND vertex3=0 (wt1, opp2, mixed3 free), so cov11>0 iff (adj2 OR vertex3) - an exact 2-bit OR equivalence on all 32 maps, never stated, and in tension with the note's own summary that c11sel found no 1-3-bit selector for cov11>0. It also states the weaker cov11>0 implies Q10 (N_pos=N_both=24, q10_false_pos=()). Consistent with #6582's closed form cov11=4+8*vertex3 on Q_*.
